refnamediv.refpurpose: Calendar difference between two datetime values

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: b = between(d1, d2) b = between(d1, d2, c)

listitem.para: A datetime value or array of datetime values.
A datetime value or array of datetime values. d1 and d2 must have compatible dimensions, or one of them must be scalar.
A string specifying the requested calendar unit. Valid values are "Years", "Months", "Days", "Time", and "default". The default value is "default".
A calendarDuration containing the difference between d1 and d2.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: between(d1,d2) computes the calendar difference between two datetime values.
When the default mode is used, the result is decomposed into calendar years, calendar months, calendar days, and a time component.
The direction of the difference is preserved. If d2 is earlier than d1, the resulting calendarDuration contains negative components.
The decomposition is designed so that adding the result to d1 reconstructs d2: d1 + b == d2

refsection.title: Unit selection
refsection.para: The third input argument selects the unit returned by between.

tr.td: returns the difference expressed in calendar years.
returns the difference expressed in total calendar months.
returns the elapsed difference expressed in days.
returns the elapsed difference as a time duration, whitout calendar years, months, or days.
returns a calendarDuration decomposed into years, months, days, and time.

para.programlisting: d1 = datetime(2026,3,30) d2 = datetime(2026,1,31) res = between(d1,d2) d1 + res == d2
para.screen:
--> d1 = datetime(2026,3,30)
d1 = [datetime]
2026-03-30
--> d2 = datetime(2026,1,31)
d2 = [datetime]
2026-01-31
--> res = between(d1,d2)
res = [calendarDuration]
-1mo -28d
--> d1 + res == d2
